title: O-RADS US v2022: An Update of the American College of Radiology Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System Ultrasound Risk Stratification and Management System
target_population: Adult female patients (pre- and postmenopausal) presenting with asymptomatic or symptomatic ovarian/adnexal masses.
intended_use: Standardizing sonographic lexicon, risk stratification into 6 categories (O-RADS 0 to 5), and directing patient triage and management recommendations.
key_updates_v2022: Refined definitions for solid lesions with smooth contour and acoustic shadowing (favoring O-RADS 2/3).
Refined criteria for bilocular cysts with smooth thin walls (categorized as O-RADS 2 if < 10 cm without solid components).
Clarified ultrasound follow-up intervals for O-RADS 3 lesions in pre- and postmenopausal women.
Integrated MRI triage recommendation for indeterminate O-RADS 3/4 lesions with equivocal solid tissue components.

O-RADS 0.name: Incomplete Evaluation
O-RADS 0.description: Obscured by bowel gas, technical inadequacy, or large mass exceeding field of view.

O-RADS 1.name: Normal Premenopausal Ovary
O-RADS 1.description: Normal follicles ≤ 30 mm, physiological corpus luteum ≤ 30 mm.

O-RADS 2.name: Almost Certainly Benign
O-RADS 2.description: Simple cyst ≤ 10 cm, classic unilocular endometrioma, dermoid cyst, or hemorrhagic cyst ≤ 10 cm without vascularized solid component.

O-RADS 3.name: Low Risk of Malignancy
O-RADS 3.description: Unilocular cyst > 10 cm, multilocular cyst < 10 cm with smooth inner wall, solid lesion with smooth contour and shadowing.

O-RADS 4.name: Intermediate Risk of Malignancy
O-RADS 4.description: Multilocular cyst ≥ 10 cm with smooth wall, multilocular cyst with irregular wall, cystic lesion with 1-3 papillary projections, solid mass without shadowing and Color Score 1-3.

O-RADS 5.name: High Risk of Malignancy
O-RADS 5.description: Solid mass with Color Score 4, multilocular cyst with solid component/papillary projections ≥ 4, presence of ascites or peritoneal nodules.
